violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Air Gap Provided
violations.observation: Observed the pre-wash spray hose to extend below the flood rim level of the sink basin at the 3-vat sink.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by providing an air gap as specified under 5-202.13. The spray hose at the 3-vat sink shall be altered to hang above the flood level rim of the 3-vat sink in order to provide an air gap. PIC HUNG UP THE HOSE DURING THE INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS THIS IS A TEMPORARY SOLUTION. PLEASE REPLACE THE HOSE WITH A SHORTER HOSE OR A LONGER SPRING TO PREVENT IT FROM SURPASSING THE FLOOD LEVEL RIM AND PROVIDE PROOF OF CORRECTION TO THE EHS WITHIN 10 DAYS.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: DIMCHAE CHEST.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PROVIDE UNIT THERMOMETER FOR REFRIGERATION UNIT.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, Design/Construction
violations.observation: Milk crate(s) found used for the following purpose(s): STORE UTENSILS AND FOOD ITEMS IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Milk crates, soda crates, and/or bread racks are not designed to store or elevate food, equipment, utensils, clean linens, and single-service items. Provide only ANSI-certified (such as NSF-listed) shelving units, storage units, or dunnage racks. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE ENSURE COMPLIANCE BY NEXT INSPECTION. EDEN ADULT DAYCARE CENTER (Inspection Date: 10/16/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: EQUIPMENT SURFACES AND UNDER COUNTERS:
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the FLOORS AND WALLS in the KITCHEN ARE in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PLEASE CLEAN AND IMPLEMENT APPROPRIATE CLEANING SCHEDULE.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: OBSERVED KIMCHI MADE TWO DAYS PRIOR TO INSPECTION WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EMPLOYEE ADDED DATE MARKING DURING INSPECTION. PIC UNDERSTANDS ALL PREPARED OR COOKED TCS FOODS KEPT FOR MORE THAN 24 HOURS SHOULD HAVE A DATE MARKING.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: PEELED GARLIC manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of VARIOUS FOOD ITEMS.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. PIC UNDERSTANDS THESE CONTAINERS SHOULD BE GRADUALLY REPLACED WITH NSF APPROVED (OR EQUIVALENT) FOOD GRADE CONTAINERS.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: OBSERVED THE HIGH TEMPERATURE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEET 152F-153F FOR MULTIPLE CYCLES; DISHWASHING MACHINE FINAL TEMPERATURE WAS 163.1F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC UNDERSTANDS DISHWASHING MACHINE SHOULD MEET 160F TO ENSURE DISHWARE IS SANITIZING AND HIGH TEMPERATURE THERMOMETER PLATE (OR TEST STRIPS) SHOULD BE USED TO ENSURE THE DISHWASHING MACHINE MEETS TEMPERATURE.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: HEAT SENSITIVE TEST STRIPS ONSITE DID NOT TURN COLOR WHEN HIGH TEMPERATURE THERMO-DISC MET 163.1F.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature. PIC PLACED ORDER FOR THERMO-DISC DURING INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: Employee personal items observed stored on dry storage shelving.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. Employee personal items removed from food storage shelving.

violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Shelving next to cookline observed wrapped with tin foil and accumulated with debris
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Please change the tin foil at a frequency to reduce debris accumulation.
